messages:
zoe: Quick UX copy pass — session activity empty row + 'clear history' warning

mike: thanks. can you paste the current copy? :eyes:

zoe: Current empty row: "No activity for this session yet. Start a request to see actions." Clear button: "Clear history" (in kebab menu). Confirmation modal title: "Clear session history" body: "Are you sure? This will permanently remove this session's activity." Cancel/Confirm: "Cancel" / "Clear"

shreya: TL;DR — language feels abrupt. two quick nits:
- empty state should give next step CTA (what does 'start a request' mean?)
- confirmation needs a milder tone and an undo option

aaron: +1. propose options:
1) Empty state CTA: "Run your first request" / subtext: "Requests show up here with timing and token cost."
2) Tooltip for clear action (on kebab): "Clear history — removes all activity for this session"
3) Confirm modal body: "This will permanently delete activity from this session. You can undo for 10s." (then show undo toast)

zoe: copy alternatives I sketched:
- empty headline: "No session activity yet"
- subtext: "Run a request to see logs, latency, and token usage."
- primary CTA: "Run a request" (blue)
- secondary link: "Learn about session logs" -> /docs/sessions

- confirm modal:
  Title: "Clear session history?"
  Body: "This deletes all entries shown for this session. This action can't be undone here, but you can undo for a short time via the toast."
  Confirm button: "Clear history"
  Cancel: "Keep activity"

shreya: wording + a11y:
- aria-label for kebab item: `Clear session history, opens confirmation dialog`
- toast copy: "Session history cleared — Undo" (button: "Undo")

mike: small nit: "can't be undone here" feels weird. maybe say "This action will remove entries and is reversible only via the Undo toast for 10s." Keep it explicit.

zoe: good call. updated modal body: "This will remove all entries for this session. You can undo this action from the toast for 10 seconds."

aaron: test variants:
A) Confirm CTA: "Clear history"
B) Confirm CTA: "Delete history"
- prefer A (less scary) but secondary text must include 'permanently' if CTA is 'Delete'

shreya: accessibility checklist:
- focus trap in modal
- escape to cancel
- aria-live region for toast
- grant 10s undo sufficient for most flows

zoe: final recs:
- update empty state copy w/ clearer CTA (Run a request)
- kebab tooltip: "Clear session history"
- confirm modal: use updated body w/ 'undo for 10 seconds'
- toast: "Session history cleared — Undo"
- aria labels as above

mike: :thumbsup: please push copy to figma and I'll sign off

aria-bot: Automation: linked doc created -> /design/copy/session-history-empty-state (auto)

zoe: added to Figma page, PTAL @mike

mike: LGTM, ship it.
